MADE UP, NOT NETWORK DATA.

Every file in this folder was written by hand in the form of the Open
Glider Network's data, https://www.glidernet.org/. None of it was received
from the network or copied from it: the network's rules, read on 2026-11-21
at https://www.glidernet.org/ogn-data-usage/, forbid passing on its data
older than 24 hours, and a file in a public repository is passed on for as
long as the repository exists; and the device database's registrations are
treated as personal data. The addresses (E00001 to E00012), registrations
(X-..., D-0000), receivers (MADEUP1 to MADEUP3; Wallberg, Neureuth and
Kreuth as names of places only), times and positions are all invented.

feed_made_up.txt   lines in the form of the APRS feed, as the network's wiki
                   describes it (http://wiki.glidernet.org/, "APRS
                   interaction examples" and "OGN flavoured APRS"), for
                   2026-11-21 shortly before 19:09:10 UTC, over the
                   Tegernsee: server comment lines; a paraglider heard
                   twice and by two receivers; a FANET paraglider; a hang
                   glider; a glider; a tow plane; a paraglider heard eleven
                   minutes before the clock; one device whose owner chose
                   not to be tracked (E00004), one whose line carries the
                   no-tracking flag (E00005), one with the stealth flag
                   (E0000A), one not to be identified (E00006); an ADS-B
                   airliner over Munich; a FANET device on the ground; a
                   Naviter line with an id field of ten digits; a line with
                   a time that is not hhmmss; a device's status line; a
                   FANET weather report; a receiver's position and status.
ddb_made_up.json   a device database in the form of
                   https://ddb.glidernet.org/download/?j=1&t=1: tracked and
                   identified, not tracked, tracked and not identified
                   (with a registration the adapter must drop), not tracked
                   and identified, one address twice with two choices, an
                   entry without the flags, and an address of the wrong
                   form. E00002, E00003, E00008 and E00009 are not in it.

The tests and the server's development mode read these files.
